items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: So we got this band together underneath the direction of Warren Binary... Warren Binary on trumpet

ctx.x: What about the zip code? Do they play paid jobs or they just?

No, Mr. Paul Blake, the postmaster, he likes jazz music. And well he found out they had a lot of talent in the post office so he said he liked to get a band together. So we got this band together underneath the direction of Warren Binary. And we rehearsed about every other Sunday. We would play dedication, play it for Flag Day. Dedication New Post Office over there in Gretna out there to miss you. And this was something that was done on our own time. We wasn't granted no kind of leave or anything. This was like…
